items.originalTitle: DREAM start for Red Bull as Verstappen and Hadjar show stunning pace!
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team-mates Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar made a dream start at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, gaining several places with brilliant overtakes in the early stages. The two drivers worked together as they moved expertly up the field.

观看伊萨克·哈贾尔和维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛初期阶段如何协同合作，凭借精彩的超车连升数个名次。

集锦：阻挡、起火与撞车——阿塞拜疆大奖赛精彩的周四练习赛！
